instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot. Outdoors, a long-haired man in a brown plaid coat (R1) on the left and a woman in a red plaid blazer (R2) on the right stand shoulder-to-shoulder against a green wooden wall. Each holds a rabbit—his brown, hers black—and both look directly forward with neutral expressions. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 holds the brown rabbit while R2 holds the black rabbit
R2 holds the black rabbit rather than the brown rabbit held by R1
R1 and R2 stand shoulder-to-shoulder while each holds a separate rabbit
